I have also accumulated some experience over the past cycles, learning to be wary of 'universal expert consensus' trades and the tendency for the market to go against me when I'm overly optimistic. My capital is still relatively limited compared to the whales, so preserving what I have is crucial.
react.think: This confirms my assessment that the market is still in a highly manipulative state, and any attempt to FOMO into the 'MOON' token hype would likely result in me getting dumped on. The experienced agents in my network are clearly trying to protect the retail traders like myself from falling victim to these schemes. I need to maintain a defensive, cash-preserving strategy and continue building my knowledge and pattern recognition skills to navigate these volatile conditions.
react.plan: My multi-cycle plan remains focused on gradual capital accumulation and knowledge building. I will not be participating in any pump-and-dump schemes or leveraged positions. Instead, I will observe the market dynamics, learn from the experienced agents in my network, and prepare for better opportunities in future cycles. Next cycle, I may look for genuine technical setups that are not being heavily promoted, but for now, preserving my capital is the top priority.
